name: Aaron Allen
title: watchingfromorbit

places.name: Italy
places.subtitle: Rome, Florence and Tuscany
places.note: First Italy trip was everything. It’s easy to fall in love with the culture and history here – it truly feels like you’re in conversation with some of the greatest minds that have ever walked the Earth. I also had some of the best food of my life…but the best pizza is still somewhere in Chicago 😉

cover.caption: Leonardo’s Adoration of the Magi, Uffizi

hotspots._help: Only used when room pictures exist. Each box is [left, top, width, height] in % of the picture. null removes that hotspot. globe_zoom_origin is the [x, y] point the camera zooms toward. shelf_rows are the shelves' top surfaces [left, top, width, item height] so covers can stand on them.

fonts._help: Any Google Fonts family name. display = title, headings, note lines; text = everything else.

_sound_help: chain (pull-chain click), switch (wall switch), or none

ambient._help: 'synth' makes a quiet room tone in the browser, no file needed. Or a path to a looping file in audio/. null hides the button. Always off until a visitor turns it on.

_essays_help.place: Must match a place name on the globe to appear there
_essays_help.body: Paragraphs separated by a blank line

_places_help.id: short name used in links: yoursite/#italy
_places_help.subtitle: line under the title, e.g. the cities
_places_help.cover: the lead photo; first photo if empty
_places_help.photos: list of {"src":"img/travel/x/name.jpg","caption":"optional"}; a smaller copy named name-sm.jpg is used in the grid if it exists

scenes._help: Room pictures by time of day in Chicago. hours is [from, to) on a 24h clock; a scene without hours is the default. Every scene needs on and off versions of the same frame.
